domainConclusions.statement: ProjectService is the canonical project persistence owner for the traced editor state, but callers do not yet converge on one command/revision/receipt contract.
Writer-issued R_after closes the post-write rollback race; exact before-state/revision capture remains open and prevents a broad rollback-race-closed claim.
Whole-state writers may omit the originating revision and updateProject writes project fields without CAS, revision advancement or receipt.
The browser edits local React state and later whole-state saves it; chat tools directly invoke multiple ProjectService methods, so UI/chat parity is not established by shared overlay shapes.
The active ProjectMutationReceiptV1 contains projectId, revision and committedAt only; it does not expose canonical command hash, changed paths, proof, timeline revisions, undo or replay bindings.
